info.title: JANUS Machine Market — Live GitHub Issues Ingress
info.description: Live machine ingress for the first-free bounded JANUS.SEARCH service. This describes the GitHub Issues transport, not a general JANUS transaction API. Telegram is not required.

post.description: Creates one bounded public-beta SEARCH request. Exactly one first new SEARCH order is free per external GitHub principal. Caller supplies its own GitHub credential.

title.const: [JANUS R1B BUYER QUERY SHADOW] Public beta request

body.description: Must contain a JANUS_BUYER_QUERY_SHADOW_JSON marker with one bounded query.

example.title: [JANUS R1B BUYER QUERY SHADOW] Public beta request
example.body: <!-- JANUS_BUYER_QUERY_SHADOW_JSON\n{"schema":"janus.machine_market.buyer_query_shadow_request.v1","message_text":"Find recent primary sources about a bounded research topic and return provenance."}\nJANUS_BUYER_QUERY_SHADOW_JSON -->

201.description: GitHub issue created; poll/read comments for the reconciled JANUS result.

401.description: Caller GitHub credential missing or invalid.

get.summary: Read JANUS result comments for an order

200.description: Issue comments. The reconciled JANUS response is returned on this surface.

githubBearer.description: Caller-supplied GitHub credential with permission to create issues in the public repository.

tags.name: JANUS.SEARCH
tags.description: Bounded research/search with provenance and receipt lineage.
